description: Figure 7 is a line plot comparing the training and validation loss for two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” is linear and ranges from 0 to 60,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is linear and spans from 2 × 10⁰ to 1.2 × 10¹, with labeled tick marks at 2 × 10⁰, 3 × 10⁰, 4 × 10⁰, 6 × 10⁰, 10¹, and 1.1 × 10¹. Four distinct lines are plotted: Ex1 Loss (solid blue line with circle markers) starts at approximately 11.0 and drops sharply to around 2.1 by 10,000 steps, then remains relatively flat near 2.0 until 60,000 steps. Ex2 Loss (solid cyan line with circle markers) begins at about 5.0, decreases rapidly to approximately 2.2 by 10,000 steps, and then gradually declines to around 2.0 by 60,000 steps. Ex1 Validation Loss (dashed blue line with circle markers) starts near 5.0, falls to approximately 3.0 by 10,000 steps, and stabilizes around 3.0 for the remainder of training. Ex2 Validation Loss (dashed cyan line with circle markers) begins at about 4.5, drops to around 2.5 by 10,000 steps, and then gradually decreases to approximately 2.2 by 60,000 steps. All lines show a general downward trend in loss over training steps, with training losses consistently lower than their corresponding validation losses.
